crawl: Chrome live crawl, same-origin fetch, cache: no-store, sequential per URL, ~06:00-07:30 Vietnam time on 2026-10-05 (two-day step from 3 Oct; there is no 4 Oct crawl)
method: TTFB measured with performance.now() around a sequential fetch of each URL with a 15 s abort. Words counted on a body clone with script/style/noscript/template removed. Schema blocks counted as application/ld+json elements, @type walked through @graph. Internal links are unique same-origin paths per page. MISSING-ALT RULE (in force since 2 Oct 2026): only visible outside
score_rationale: Health 97 -> 97 (raw 96.65 -> 96.65; weights .25/.25/.20/.15/.15). Two-day step from 3 Oct (no 4 Oct crawl). Every sub-score holds: CRAWLABILITY 98 (118/118 return 200, zero orphans (day count 24), zero hub-only articles, /articles overlay still absent, but the site-wide promoted template link is still missing: 2,711 distinct internal links, unchanged from 3 Oct); PERFORMANCE 98 (TTFB mean 326 ms, median 272 ms, ceiling 818 ms, all 118 pages under 1 s - the ceiling is higher than 3 Oct's 714 ms but the band is the same, so the score is held on judgement); STRUCTURED DATA 98 (116/118 pages with schema, FAQPage 95/95 articles, 407 JSON-LD blocks); ON-PAGE 94 (118/118 one H1, title, meta description, self canonical; 0 heading skips; 0 images missing alt under the visible- rule); CONTENT 93 (corpus 241,675 words unchanged, still no new article since 24 Sep). Ahrefs Site Audit errors are reported separately in ahrefs_site_audit and do not feed this score.

pages.note: Fresh crawl: 117 sitemap HTML pages plus /login, plus /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt checked separately. All 118 HTML pages returned 200; page set unchanged.

sitemap.linked_absent_method: Measured this run from the inbound-link graph over all 118 crawled pages, counting only same-origin HTML paths.
sitemap.legacy_recheck_note: The ten legacy long-slug article URLs were re-fetched today from the origin at /articles/<slug>: ten of ten returned 200 with a self-referencing canonical, unchanged - a seventeenth clean recheck.

ttfb_ms.note: Single sequential pass, same method. Site mean 327 -> 326.0 ms, median 274.5 -> 271.5 ms, ceiling 714 -> 818 ms; core 414.1, articles 313.3, projects 276.5 ms. All 118 pages under 1 s.

content.note: Corpus 241675 words, identical to 3 Oct on every page; hub /articles still 1,067 words. No new article (last: 24 Sep, 11 calendar days ago). Same 13 pages under 300 words.

schema.note: FAQPage on 95 of 95 articles (100 pct) for a third scan; JSON-LD blocks 407 unchanged. 116 of 118 pages carry schema; /login and /start-interactive remain empty.

heading_skips.note: No heading level is skipped anywhere on the site.

onpage.note: MISSING-ALT RULE (since 2 Oct): visible only; Facebook tracking pixels inside

crawlability.note: Template promoted link still missing: total distinct internal links 2,711 -> 2,711 (average 23.0), unchanged from 3 Oct. Zero orphans and zero hub-only articles in the inbound-link graph of all 118 pages. OVERLAY FIX HELD (sixth read): /articles live load, zero elements at z-index >= 9999, zero fixed full-viewport elements, elementFromPoint at centre is an ordinary content div; 95 article links in DOM, 109 distinct internal paths on the hub.

tag_check.note: Tag check on homepage: window.google_tag_manager exposes 17 keys including GTM-PZ9N8QTR, AW-18039433307 and G-43HE633LGK; dataLayer length 3 on /, 4 on /articles; window.gtag undefined (GTM loads the tags). llms.txt 200 (12,678 bytes), llms-full.txt 200 (21,940 bytes), robots.txt 200 (430 bytes).

roadmap: P0 - restore the template link: the site-wide promoted link is still missing from 94 of 95 articles (2,805 -> 2,711 since 2 Oct); ask the WordPress admin to check the template.
P0 - publish a new article. Eleven calendar days without one keeps Content at 93 and gives Google no freshness signal.

P1 - review the Ahrefs Site Audit errors (16 internal URLs with errors, 1 404/4XX, 2 pages with links to a broken page, 25 3XX redirects) and the 20 over-long titles; fix the 404 target and the broken links first.
P1 - decide on /studio title, H1 and meta for "3d rendering services melbourne" and on 40-60 word answer blocks for the 8 service pages (drafted, not yet applied); 9 article blocks are live.
P1 - the Ahrefs crawl hit its Max internal pages cap (232 URLs): raise the cap so its Health reflects the whole site.
P2 - watch TTFB: site mean 327 -> 326 ms, ceiling 714 -> 818 ms, all pages under 1 s.
process_note: ONE crawl serves both this audit and the SEO report, so TTFB, word counts, schema counts and the internal-link graph agree between the two reports by construction. A second full pass later the same morning (used for h1/title/meta/canonical/heading/alt checks and the inbound graph) matched the first on words 241,675, JSON-LD 407, images 1,269 and lazy 773.
repeat_measurements_note: Re-measured this run: four cache-busted (?cb=) fetches each of /, /studio and /articles; navigation timing from a fresh browser load of / and /articles (TTFB = responseStart).

ahrefs_site_audit.issues_note: Read from Site Audit > All issues (Actual 33 types). Severity colours are not exposed in the page text, so issues are listed by category as Ahrefs groups them; the 17 errors / 419 warnings / 480 notices split is the overview total. "Change" is the Ahrefs change column against the previous crawl. Hundreds of the flagged URLs are noindex/nofollow resource-like URLs on the Ahrefs-crawled 232 internal set, which is wider than the 118 sitemap pages.

cross_check.agreement: This audit finds 118 of 118 pages at 200, one H1, one title, a meta description and a self canonical, and 0 images missing alt. Ahrefs flags 1 404/4XX URL, 2 pages with a missing meta description or H1 and 20 titles too long that sit outside the 118-page sitemap set or use a different length threshold, so they are listed here and not folded into the Health score.
